name: USDJPY carry-unwind risk-off guard — de-risk crypto when the yen-carry funding currency snaps stronger
rationale: MECHANISM: the yen is the world's cheap funding currency; a sharp USDJPY DROP (yen strengthening) is the tell of a global carry-trade UNWIND, which forces levered risk positions across every asset to be cut — the Aug-2024 and 2025 crypto air-pockets both coincided with violent yen-carry unwinds. Because crypto is the highest-beta leveraged sleeve, a carry unwind hits it hard and fast. Guard: flatten/short crypto beta when usdjpy breaks down sharply (yen strength) AND crypto momentum has already rolled over (negative ret_Nd) — capturing the carry-unwind drawdown a long-only book eats in full. Counterparty = the levered-long crowd slow to recognize the funding shock. DISCONFIRMER: usdjpy is a fast FX series but the carry-unwind link is regime-specific (only bites when carry is crowded); in normal regimes a yen wobble is noise. Kill if the avoided-drawdown net of extra round-trip fees does not beat holding through, or if it fires so rarely (true carry unwinds are rare) that effective N is too low to trust.
catalyst: sharp yen strengthening (carry unwind) with crypto momentum rolling over
